title: Policy: Fail-Open vs Fail-Closed guidance + Half-Fixed acceptance checklist
description:
Create a policy doc task to codify fail-open vs fail-closed cases and add an acceptance checklist to avoid half-fixed patches.

Acceptance criteria:
- Draft policy in Data/Pages/policies/fail-open-fail-closed.md
- Add checklist template to PR template; require "adjacent invariants" section
- Add tests/automation hook that verifies presence of adjacent-invariants checklist for security-sensitive PRs

Effort: 3-5h
